greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, igu hagaaji jidka weligeed ah.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban. Maanta, waxaan u dabaaldegaynaa Malaa'igta Ilaalinta, kuwaas oo ah wehelka joogtada ah ee Ilaah inoo soo diray si ay inoo xafidaan.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa albaabka. Akhriska koowaad ee Job, waxaan ka maqlaynaa Ilaah oo la hadlaya Job isagoo ka imanaya duufaan, wuxuuna waydiinayaa: 'Ma laguu muujiyey irridaha dhimashada, mise ma aragtay irridaha mugdiga?' Job wuxuu ahaa nin raadinayay jawaabo, nin raba inuu fahmo sababta nolosha iyo dhimashada ay u leeyihiin xuduudo aan la fahmi karin. Laakiin Ilaah wuxuu u sheegayaa in xuduudahaas ay yihiin kuwo uu isagu gacanta ku hayo. Ben, wiilkeenna qaaliga ah, wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu albaabbada adduunkan furo. Xusuusnow sida uu u jeclaa inuu 'airport spotting' sameeyo, isagoo eegaya diyaaradaha oo ka kacaya garoomada adduunka, isagoo rajaynaya inuu maalin uun maamulo 'Con Chim Airlines'. Wuxuu ahaa wiil albaabbada mustaqbalka u furayay maskaxdiisa iyo qalbigiisa.

Laakiin intaanan halkaas sii marin, waa inaan si daacad ah u wajahno xanuunka. Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo uu xusuustaada kusoo dhaco dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. Xusuusnow, xataa markii uu 15 sano jir ahaa, Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil qalbi saafi ah oo rabay inuu u huro wax walba uu haysto si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William. Taasi waa dabeecadda wiilka aad koriseen, waana midda Ilaah uu ku farxo.

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu u yeeray ilmo, wuxuuna dhex dhigay xertiisa. Wuxuu yiri: 'Malaa'igtoodu waxay had iyo goor eegaan wejiga Aabbahayga jannada ku jira.' Ben hadda wuxuu ku jiraa meel aanay jirin daal, meel aanay jirin baahida loo qabo in la sugo diyaarad ama la dhiso shirkad. Wuxuu ku jiraa 'Banquet of Heaven', isagoo la jooga malaa'igta. Wuxuu idin leeyahay, iyadoo dhoola caddaynaya: 'Ha murugoonina.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugan tahay Sacrament-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa codsanayaa inaad qalbigayga soo gasho oo aad igu dhex noolaato, si aan weligay kaaga go'in.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo oo ha idin xafido. Nabadda Masiixu ha idinla jirto had iyo goor.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Benjamin iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Ilaah u furay albaabbada jannada oo uu ku dejiyay iftiinka wajigiisa, aan Rabbiga u barino.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska saaran, inuu Ilaah siiyo rajo, nabad, iyo awood ay ku sii wadaan nolosha iyagoo is-jacayl leh, aan Rabbiga u barino.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Rabbigu wuxuu Job kaga jawaabay duufaantii, wuxuuna ku yiri: 'Weligaa ma amartay subaxdii, oo ma tustay waaberigii meeshiisii? Si uu u qabsado dhulka geesihiisa, oo sharka looga ruxo dushiisa? Dhulku wuxuu isu beddelaa sida dhoobada oo kale marka shaabadda la saaro, waana la midabeeyaa sida dhar oo kale; laakiin sharka iftiinka waa laga fogeeyaa, gacanta kibirka lehna waa la jebiyaa. Ma gashay ilaha badda, mise waxaad ku socotay gunta qoto dheer? Ma laguu muujiyey irridaha dhimashada, mise ma aragtay irridaha mugdiga? Ma fahantay dhulka ballaciisa? Ii sheeg haddaad wax walba ogtahay: Waa maxay jidka loo maro halka iftiinka laga dego, xaggee bayse tahay meesha mugdiga? Si aad u geyso xuduudahooda oo aad u dhigto waddooyinkooda guriga ku haga? Waayo waad ogtahay, maxaa yeelay waxaad dhalatay iyaga ka hor, tirada sannadahaaguna waa badan yihiin!' Markaasuu Job Rabbiga u jawaabay oo ku yiri: 'Bal eeg, anigu waxba kama ihi; maxaan kaga jawaabi karaa? Gacantayda ayaan afka saaray. In kasta oo aan mar hadlay, mar dambe ma samayn doono; in kasta oo aan laba jeer hadlay, mar dambe ma samayn doono.'

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Rabbiyow, igu hagaaji jidka weligeed ah. Rabbiyow, waad i baartay, waadna i taqaannaa; waad og tahay markaan fadhiisto iyo markaan istaago; fikradahayga waad ka fahantay meel fog. Safarradayda iyo nasashadayda waad baartaa, dhammaan waddooyinkayga waad taqaannaa. Xaggee baan ka tegi karaa Ruuxaaga? Xaggee baan ka dhuuman karaa joogitaankaaga? Haddaan samada u koco, halkaas ayaad joogtaa; haddaan ku hoobto meesha dhimashada, halkaas ayaad joogtaa. Haddaan qaato baalasha waaberiga, haddaan ku nasto badda geesaheeda ugu fog, halkaas xitaa gacantaadu way i hagi doontaa, gacantaadana midigta ah ayaa i qaban doonta. Runtii waxaad samaysay qaybahayga gudaha; waad igu toshay caloosha hooyaday. Waan ku mahadinayaa inaad si cabsi leh oo layaab leh ii samaysay; shaqadaadu waa layaab.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Xertii ayaa u timid Ciise oo ku tiri: 'Yaa ugu weyn Boqortooyada jannada?' Wuxuu u yeeray ilmo, wuxuuna dhex dhigay iyaga, wuxuuna yiri: 'Runtii waxaan idinku leeyahay, haddii aydun u soo noqon oo aydun noqon sida carruurta, Boqortooyada jannada ma geli doontaan. Qofkii is-hoosaysiiya sida ilmahani oo kale, isagaa ugu weyn Boqortooyada jannada. Qofkii ilmo sidan oo kale ah magacayga ku qaabila, isagu wuu i qaabilay. Ka digtoonaada inaad quudhsataan mid ka mid ah kuwa yaryar, waayo waxaan idin leeyahay, malaa'igtoodu waxay jannada ku dhex jiraan, iyagoo had iyo goor eega wejiga Aabbahayga jannada ku jira.'

day: Memorial of the Holy Guardian Angels

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.
